summary: The Case Reserve Adequacy User Value row is entered like a spreadsheet cell, accepts formulas and Excel links, and lists its links on a new Links tab.
details: Click a User Value cell and type to enter a figure; Enter commits, Escape abandons, Tab moves along the row, and Delete clears the cell back to the grid's default estimator.
A cell accepts a number, an arithmetic formula with ROUND, or a pasted Excel cell reference; a pasted range fills the row to the right, one cell per column.
The Links tab lists every workbook cell the User Value rows read, refreshes or hard-codes them, and warns when saved values no longer match the workbook.
